name: hero
facts: Every skill lives at skills/<name>/SKILL.md, with optional reference/, scripts/, and assets/ directories
npx skills add apatheticus/skills writes editable copies of the skills into a project
The Claude Code channel adds the marketplace once, then installs apatheticus-skills and apatheticus-security as separate managed sets
Both channels read the same skills/ directory; both marketplace entries source the repository root and each lists its own subset
scripts/validate.mjs validates every skill and both plugin entries in marketplace.json
